logical_coherence.description: Evaluates transition clarity, sequential experiment logic, and clear narrative funnel.

scientific_rigor.description: Checks for proper controls, p-values, N-values, and correct statistical comparisons.

balanced_claims.description: Assesses if conclusions match data and if hedging language is used appropriately (especially for exploratory data).

format_and_style.description: Verifies citation completeness, abbreviation consistency, and target journal standard compliance.
